scope: DG-022-style zero-update supervision verification extended to the JB-002 counter-example panel: time-qualified refusals and hypothesis/relay refusals through the query-only branch, plus time-scoped-value and multi-fact-distractor trajectories through the FineSpanReader static/idle supervision. Zero optimizer steps, no free generation, no serving.
compile_gate: All 20 panel trajectories compile via compile_teacher_time (delegation for route-2 incl. time-qualified refusals after the registered delegation fix; DG-025 time branch for historical_stated). Pinned per-record position counts must match exactly.
feature_gate: Panel query and source texts are encoded by the frozen encoder probe into a NEW local bank (build/neural-memory-jb002-features) with its own manifest; the frozen CG-003 feature package is read-only and untouched. Texts, token ids and encoder identity are hash-recorded.
uncertainty_gate: Per-token CE of the untrained query-only branch at every teacher position (fresh C prefix frames, batch extraction + first/middle/last reference bitwise checks per record); equal-weight aggregate backward reproduces the zero-init chain rule (Wout nonzero, encoder exactly zero); disabled identity at every position; zero residual bitwise base at every position; parameters unchanged.
supported_gate: For each historical_stated/multi_fact trajectory: reader static fine_loss (route/span targets incl. the 2020 value span) and idle-mode CE backward at actual C idle prefixes; finite nonzero gradients with coarse/fine heads connected on positives; parameters unchanged. Reader weights re-initialized from the DG-020 seed and digest-checked.
limits: Small smoke-level panel on one frozen world; passing numerical gates is not memory ability. No LoCoMo, no test split, no serving, no budget consumption.
stop: Keep every failure; fix only the new modules; pinned files and prior reports must hash-verify unchanged before and after.
